note: Reviewed identity decisions: one record per person. Splits move what v69 or an import credited to the wrong person; merges fold duplicates into one record (a merge into an ID that does not exist yet renames the first record). Apply with `node scripts/identity-fixes.ts`; applying twice changes nothing. A split with a v69 block makes the same move in the v69 snapshot for parity (scripts/migrate/v69/corrections.ts).

splits.reason: The 2007-08 matches billed "Deuce" (Deuce 'n Domino on SmackDown, then Raw singles matches in September 2008) are James Reiher Jr., Deuce and later Sim Snuka. v69 matched them to LA Knight because his profile listed Deuce as an alias; Shaun Ricker did not reach WWE television until 2013.

v69 filed Yoshiki Inamura's 2025 NXT run (February to August) under the ID it later used for Naraku, and the profile import filled that ID from EVIL's page. Inamura, of Pro Wrestling NOAH, and EVIL are different men; every 2025 segment names Inamura.

Sin Cara is a mask two men wore. Luis Urive (Místico) left WWE early in 2014; Kalisto's Lucha Dragons partner when they won the NXT tag titles in September 2014 was the second Sin Cara, Jorge Arias (Hunico).
The Executioner is a hood several men wore. At WrestleMania I (March 31, 1985), where Tito Santana beat him, it was Buddy Rose.
The Executioner the Undertaker beat at In Your House: It's Time (December 15, 1996) was Terry Gordy under the hood.
The NWF Heavyweight Champion of 1973 printed "Jacques Rougeau" is the father: Jacques Rougeau Jr., of the Quebecers and the Mountie, was born in 1960 and debuted in 1977.
